$comment: Time-boxed exceptions for the all-dependencies audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs).
Only HIGH and CRITICAL advisories are enforced; production dependencies are
audited separately in CI with no exceptions at all.
Each entry requires: package, id (GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx), expires (YYYY-MM-DD), reason.
An entry stops suppressing the advisory once expires has passed, so CI starts
failing again unless the entry is renewed or the dependency is fixed.
Use this only for advisories with no patched release, or whose only fix is a
breaking downgrade of a parent package. Never use it for production dependencies.
